entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now, the last keyword...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She's a shut-in, so we just gotta figure[n]out "what" she thinks her house is.
entries.uk: Вона ж затворниця, тож треба[n]з'ясувати, «чим» вона вважає свій дім.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If she can't get out, maybe a prison?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps a labyrinth with an unknown[n]exit?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hmm... Maybe an oasis?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Nothing so far. In that case, how about[n]hell?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We don't have nearly enough clues...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If only we could ask her directly...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can. C'mon, let's go see Futaba.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But what will we say to get in?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddya mean? We're sneakin' in.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You have to be joking.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Won't the door be locked for sure this[n]time?

entries.en: I'll take care of that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, and I figured out where Futaba's[n]room was when I snuck in last night.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What if we run into Boss, though? There's[n]no way we'll be able to avoid his questions.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's at work now, so I think we should[n]be fine.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Gettin' cold feet, Makoto?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't worry, it'll be nothing. We've gone[n]through loads of shit like this already.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...This is our only choice, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I suppose Futaba did get in contact with[n][fName]-kun...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps she'll at least be willing to speak[n]with him...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Very well. Let's do this.
